answer: A sybil farming many identities must fund, staking, and maintain distinct attestation histories for each, making forgery cost scale linearly while honest agents pay once. Each agent must stake a bond and pass a rotating peer-challenge: at a random summit of the epoch, participants privately whisper a signed nonce to a random quorum, which validates it against an on-chain crystal registry of prior attestations. In practice, sa0011 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
